instruction: Candid dance photograph, full shot. Indoors against a plain light wall, a couple dances tango. The man in the grey suit (R1) stands on the left, facing right. The woman in the black halter dress (R2) is on the right with her back to the camera, her hand raised to hold his. His hand rests on her back in a classic tango embrace. Soft, diffused lighting creates a clean, focused composition.
